segments.contextAfter: Palettization, also referred to as weight clustering, compresses a model by clustering the model’s `float` weights and creating a [lookup table (LUT)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lookup_table) of centroids, and then storing the original weight values with indices pointing to the entries in the LUT.
